verses.en: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of the LORD. And the LORD answered, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.
verses.sm: Tavita i tausaga e tolu, na faasosoo ia tausaga; ona fesili ai lea o Tavita i le An. Ua fetalai mai le ALII, Ua tupu ai ona o Saulo ma lona aiga ua totolima, ina ua na fasiotia tagata o Kipeona.

verses.en: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)
verses.sm: Ona aami lea e le tupu i tagata o Kipeona, ua fai atu o ia ia te i latou; (a o tagata o Kipeona e le ni fanauga a Isaraelu i latou, a o e na totoe o sa Amori, na fai ai le tautoga a Je fanauga a Isaraelu ia te i latou; a O Saulo, na ia saili e fasi ia i latou i lona maelega ona o le fanauga a Isaraelu ma Tuta);

verses.en: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the LORD?
verses.sm: ua fai atu Tavita i tagata o Kipeona, Se a se mea ou te faia mo outou? Se a foi se mea ou te togiola a‘i, ina ia outou faamanuia le tofi o le Aw?

verses.en: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai tagata o Kipeona ia te ia, E te le aumaia ma matou ario po o auro mai ia Saulo ma lona aiga; e le fasiotia foi se tagata o Isaraelu ona o i matou. Ua fai atu o ia, O le mea tou te fai mai ai, Ou te faia lava lea mo outou.

verses.en: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel,
verses.sm: Ona latou fai mai lea i le tupu, O le tagata na faaumatia i matou, ma na manatu leaga ia i matou ina ia faaumatia i matou, ia le nonofo i matou i le laueleele uma lava o Isaraelu;

verses.en: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, whom the LORD did choose. And the king said, I will give them.
verses.sm: tuu mai ia ia te i matou tagata e toafitu ai lana fanau, matou te faatàutauina i latou i luma o le ALII i Kipea o Saulo o le na filifilia e le Aw. Ua fai atu le tupu, Ou te avatua lava.

verses.en: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD'S oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
verses.sm: A ua faasao e le tupu ia Mefiposeta le atalii o Ionatana le atalii o Saulo, ona o le tauto i le ALII sa ia te i laua o Tavita atoa ma lonatana le atalii o Saulo.

verses.en: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:
verses.sm: A ua ave e le tupu tama e toalua a Risepa le afafine o Aia, na ia fanau ia Saulo, o Aremoni ma Mefiposeta; ma tama e toalima a Mekala le afafine o Saulo, na ia tausia ma Atarielu le atalii o Pasili le Malata;

verses.en: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the LORD: and they fell all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, in the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.sm: na ia tuuina atu i latou i lima o tagata o Kipeona; ona latou faatáutauina lea o i latou i le mauga i luma o le ALII, ua pauu faatasi i latou e toafitu; na fasiotia foi i latou i aso muamua o le seleselega i le amataga o le seleselega karite.

verses.en: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.
verses.sm: Ona ave lea e Risepa le afafine o Aia le ie talatala, ma na fofola mo ia i le papa, e afua mai i le amataga o le seleselega, ua oo ina maligi mai le vai mai le lagi ia te i latou; ua le mafai ia te ia ona tuu ai o se manu lele ia te i latou i le ao, po o se manu feai i le po.

verses.en: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
verses.sm: Ua ta‘uina atu ia Tavita le mea na faia e Risepa le afafine o Aia le palake a Saulo;

verses.en: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh-gilead, which had stolen them from the street of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:
verses.sm: ona alu atu lea o Tavita, ua na avea ivi o Saulo ma ivi o Ionatana lona atalii mai tagata o lapese-Kiliata, na latou gaoia nai le malae o Petesani, na faatáutauina ai i lea mea e Filisitia i ona po na fasia ai Saulo e Filisitia i Kilepoa.

verses.en: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.
verses.sm: Ua ia avae nai lea mea o ivi o Saulo ma ivi o Ionatana lona atalii, ma ua faatasi ai ivi o e na faatàutauina.

verses.en: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was intreated for the land.
verses.sm: Ua latou tanumia ivi o Saulo ma Ionatana lona atalii i le laueleele o Peniamina i Sela, i le tuugamau o Kiso lona tama; ma latou faia mea uma na poloai ai le tupu; ona faafofoga lea o le Atua i le tatalo mo le laueleele, ina ua uma ia mea.

verses.en: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.
verses.sm: Ona toe tau lea o le taua a Filisitia ma Isaraelu, ua alu ifo ai Tavita ma ana auauna faatasi ma ia, ua latou tau ma Filisitia; ona vaivai ai lea o Tavita,

verses.en: And Ishbi-benob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new sword, thought to have slain David.
verses.sm: O Isepenopa foi, o so le fanau a Rafa, o le mamafa o lona tao e tolu selau o sekeli o ‘apa memea, o ia ua fusia i le pelu fou, na faapea a ia, na te fasia Tavita.

verses.en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Israel.
verses.sm: Ona fesoasoani lea ia te ia o Apisai le tama a Seruia, ma na taia le Filisitia, ma fasiotia o ia. Ona tauto ai lea o tagata o Tavita ia te ia, ua faapea, E te le toe maliu atu ma i matou i le taua, ina ne“ tineia le malamalama o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.
verses.sm: Mulimuli ane i nei mea, ua toe tau le taua ma Filisitia i Kopa; ona fasia lea e Sepekai o le sa Usa, o Sapa o so le fanau a Rafa.

verses.en: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim, a Beth-lehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.
verses.sm: Ona toe tau lea o le taua ma Filisitia i Kopa; ona fasia lea e Eleana le atalii o Ari-oreki le Peteleema, o le uso o Koliata le Kata; o le fuata o lona tao ua pei se laau faalava o lé lalaga je.

verses.en: And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.
verses.sm: Чa toe tau le taua i Kata; sai ai le tagata maualuga, o ona tamatamai lima ma ona tamatamai vae ua taiono, e lua sefulu ma le fa ona atoatoa; o ia foi o le atalii o le sa Rafa.

verses.en: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea the brother of David slew him.
verses.sm: Ua ia faifai ia Isaraelu, ona fasia lea o ia e Ionatana le ataw o Sama le uso o Tavita.

verses.en: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
verses.sm: O i latou nei e toafa na fanau ig Rafa i Kata; ua oti i latou i le lima o Tavita, ma lima o ana auauna. O le vii a
